description: This file defines the OrangeHrmSettings class which provides centralized configuration loading for the OrangeHRM Selenium NUnit test framework. It reads environment variables and MSBuild properties to configure browser setup, discovery-only mode, and login credentials.

classes.name: OrangeHrmSettings
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for loading and storing configuration settings for the test automation framework, supporting environment variable overrides and default values.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Static method that loads configuration settings from environment variables and MSBuild properties, providing defaults when variables are unset.

methods.name: ReadBoolEnv
methods.description: Helper method to parse boolean environment variables, supporting various true/false string representations.
